text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, January 29, 2018 Posted by admin on January 29th,   Home Depot, Intel (INTC), JPMorgan (JPM), Coca Cola (KO), McDonald’s (MCD), 3M (MMM), Microsoft (MSFT), Nike (NKE), Pfizer (PFE), Travelers (TRV), UnitedHealth   That’s half the Dow 30 at new highs! There  37 points. 
Friday the Dow was up +223.92 (+0.85%) at 26,616.71. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +7.68%. 
There were 25 Dow stocks up Friday. 
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Intel (INTC) +10.55% and Pfizer (PFE) +4.78%. 
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) -1.36% and Procter & Gamble (PG) -0.69%. 
Apple (AAPL) is said to be cutting first-quarter iPhone product in half due to slower-than-expected holiday sales. 
European stocks are mostly higher   two-tenths of a cent at $2.579   reports earnings on 1/30/2018 before the market open.
